nodes.label: LeadTrack CRM
nodes.rationale: A custom sales and business-development CRM built on SolidX.

nodes.label: SolidX Framework
nodes.rationale: The application platform providing metadata models, repository security, audit history, scheduling, import/export, and UI views.

nodes.label: CRM User Model
nodes.rationale: Child model of the core user model following the lmUser pattern.

nodes.label: Pipeline Stage Static Selection
nodes.rationale: Stage is metadata on Lead rather than a separate entity, enabling configuration and Kanban grouping.

nodes.label: Repository Row-Level Security
nodes.rationale: Repository-layer enforcement is required so permissions also govern search, export, and dashboard aggregates.
